summary: REPAIR #9 VALIDATION — PASS. Frontend-only validation of the New Note template-selection premature-unmount bug fix in Iron Rabbit PWA v171. Seeded a TEST_ template via localforage (name/title/content/color=green/icon=Star/background/category=TEST_Cat/subcategory=TEST_Sub), opened New Note via FAB, opened Templates picker, clicked the template row. Verified: (a) TemplateModal closed, (b) parent New Note dialog stayed open (the primary regression check), (c) no navigation to Home, (d) all 7 template fields propagated into the editor state, (e) Save persisted the note with correct fields, (f) reload preserved the note in IndexedDB, (g) existing-note edit hides the Templates button, (h) 2nd new-note reuse re-opens picker cleanly (no stale portal). Zero console errors, zero page errors, zero Radix DialogTitle/Description warnings. Cleanup left 0 test artifacts.

critical_code_review_comments: TemplateModal.jsx correctly removed early-return; Radix Dialog owns lifecycle. Fix is minimal and correct.
NoteModal.jsx line 404 defensive onOpenChange guard is a good belt-and-suspenders pattern; will prevent similar bugs from other nested Dialogs in the future.

Note: NoteModal.jsx line 400 still has `if (!isOpen) return null;` — this is fine at the top level (parent controls it) but consider whether the same early-return anti-pattern could exist elsewhere in the codebase for nested Radix Dialogs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iron Rabbit is offline-first PWA. localforage NOT exposed on window — must be injected via CDN each Playwright run (fresh context). Use FAB [data-testid='fab-add-note'] to open New Note (not button[title*='New'] which matches QuickGuide). The QuickGuide dialog may auto-open on fresh load — dismiss via [data-testid='quickguide-close-btn'] before interacting with FAB. Template picker opens a nested Radix Dialog (2 role='dialog' during picker, 1 after selection). CACHE_NAME='iron-rabbit-v171'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — Repair #9 fix (removing `if(!isOpen)return null;` in TemplateModal + defensive onOpenChange guard in NoteModal) is verified working. Root cause was synchronous unmount of nested Radix Dialog mid-pointer-event causing parent's onPointerDownOutside to fire. Fix hands lifecycle back to Radix's DismissableLayer stack.
